record.d: Folding fans of bamboo ribs and decorated paper made in Kyoto, Uji, Kameoka and Nantan, designated a Japanese traditional craft in 1977, as cooling, ceremonial, performing and decorative fans.

makers.n: Kyoto Fan and Uchiwa Manufacturers Cooperative Association

items.why: Designated craft product with an origin; an origin version of the existing Folding fan (beside the generic Sensu archetype).

record.d: Folding fan with a pleated paper or silk leaf hand-painted in gouache, made in Valencia and Aldaia since the 18th century; Valencia makes about 70% of Spanish fans.
record.dt: paper or silk leaf · wood or bone sticks

items.why: Origin version of Folding fan; the painting vocabulary stays in VE.
